name: Detective Reynolds
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues, exhaust Detective Reynolds: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Discover 1 clue from your location or a revealed connecting location.

name: Fang of Zburamoarte
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] for this attack. As an additional cost to activate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to reveal 2 chaos tokens for this skill test instead of 1 (resolve both tokens). This attack deals +1 damage for each [blood] token revealed during this test.

name: Sanguine Song
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +3 [intellect] for this investigation. As an additional cost to activate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to reveal 2 chaos tokens for this skill test instead of 1 (resolve both tokens). If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue for each [blood] token revealed during this test.

name: Forged Permit
text: [fast] Discard Forged Permit: Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, ignoring its resource cost. You may resolve an [action] ability on that asset, ignoring its [action] cost.

name: Chosen of Zburamoarte
text: Permanent. Reward. Chosen of Zburamoarte begins the game (Fighting the Hunger) side faceup. Forced - When the game begins: Add 5 [blood] tokens to the chaos bag for the duration of the game. Each investigator treats each [blood] token revealed during a skill test as "-1. Reveal another token. After this test resolves, flip the Chosen of Zburamoarte asset, (Compelled to Feed) side faceup, and seal this token on it."

name: Chosen of Zburamoarte
text:
Permanent. Reward.
You get +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
Each investigator treats each [blood] token revealed during a skill test as "-1. Reveal another token. After this test resolves, seal this token on the Chosen of Zburamoarte asset."
[fast] Exhaust this card and release 1 [blood] token sealed on it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location and heal 1 damage. If there are no [blood] tokens sealed here, flip this card.

name: Charlie Kane
text:
You have 2 additional ally slots.
[reaction] After Charlie Kane enters play: Play another [[Ally]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2.

name: The Blood Blight
text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Forced - When the round ends: Search the chaos bag for a [blood] token and seal it on your investigator. [action] Deal up to 3 damage to an investigator at your location: Release that many [blood] tokens from your investigator. If you dealt 3 damage by this effect, remove 1 [blood] token from the chaos bag.
